name: 43725 · Cambridge, OH
findings: ZIP 43725 (Cambridge) has 91 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43725 (Cambridge) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
